description: Low-angle night photograph of a white colonial-style church steeple against a dark sky, with a lit lantern glowing in the arched belfry window. The architecture is consistent with the Old North Church in Boston, famous for the two-lantern signal of Paul Revere's ride ('one if by land, two if by sea'). A brick building with one lit window is at left.
flags: Location consistent with Old North Church, Boston but not confirmed by any text in the image

description: Dark-themed grid graphic of 21 tiles (7 rows x 3 columns), each showing a black-and-white portrait of a former FBI or DOJ official with name and title, overlaid with a red grunge 'FIRED' stamp (Randy Coleman's stamp is partially illegible). Several people appear twice (Josh Campbell, John Carlin, Mary McCord). The graphic presents the claim that all of these officials were fired; in reality many resigned, retired or were reassigned, and several labeled 'FORMER FBI' actually held DOJ positions.
text: James Comey FORMER FBI Director. FIRED. Andrew McCabe FORMER FBI Deputy Director. FIRED. Josh Campbell FORMER FBI Special Assistant to Director Comey. FIRED. Jim Rybicki FORMER FBI Chief of Staff and Senior Counselor. FIRED. James Baker FORMER FBI General Counsel. FIRED. John Carlin FORMER FBI Assistant Attorney General Head of DOJ National Sec. Div. FIRED. Bill Priestap FORMER FBI Director of Counterintelligence. FIRED. Peter Strozok FORMER FBI Deputy Assistant Director of Counterintelligence. FIRED. Mary McCord FORMER FBI Acting Assistant Attorney General. FIRED. Lisa Page FORMER FBI Office of General Counsel. FIRED. Mike Kortan FORMER FBI Assistant Director for Public Affairs. FIRED. John Carlin FORMER FBI Assistant Attorney General Head of DOJ National Sec. Div. FIRED. Sally Yates FORMER FBI Deputy Attorney General & Acting Attorney General. FIRED. flags: Graphic's 'FIRED' claim is unverified/inaccurate for many listed — most resigned, retired or were reassigned rather than fired
Several DOJ officials (Yates, Carlin, McCord, Brand, Laufman) are mislabeled 'FORMER FBI'
Image misspells Peter Strzok as 'Strozok' and John Giacalone as 'Glacalone'
Randy Coleman's stamp is partially illegible ('RE—D'), possibly 'REMOVED' or 'REASSIGNED'

description: Multi-panel research collage with red boxes and connecting lines advancing the theory that the Star Wars Commander game's in-game chat was a covert comms channel. Forum threads reporting chat outages are paired by date with mass-shooting summaries: a Jun 28 2018 'ISSUE: In-Game Chat Disabled' thread linked to the Capital Gazette shooting (Annapolis, Jun 28 2018), a Jul 22 2018 'No visible chat after loading commander' thread linked to the 2018 Toronto Danforth shooting, and an Apr 20 2018 'In game chat worse than ever...' thread linked to a CNN article on a Florida high-school shooting. Right side shows Q drops 4000 (the Star Wars Commander/SIGINT drop), 3994 and 3995 ('How does Soros/China comm [secure] w/ DNC leaders?'), and 3872 ('GAME OVER'), with the game's Jun 12 2020 closure announcement (purchases suspended 03.13.20) connected by a red line to the GAME OVER drop.
text: Key phrases (collage summarized; small body text partially cropped): ISSUE: In-Game Chat Disabled. Thu Jun 28, 2018 6:46 pm. On all 3 of my Accounts I am seeing 'Chat is currently disabled. Please try again later.'. Sons_of_Death. Capital Gazette shooting. Start date: June 28, 2018. Location: Annapolis, MD. Number of deaths: 5. Attack type: Mass shooting. No visible chat after loading commander. Sun Jul 22, 2018 10:54 am. 2018 Toronto shooting. Start date: July 22, 2018. Location: Danforth Avenue, Toronto, Canada. Total number of deaths: 3 (including the perpetrator). Injuries (nonfatal): 13. In game chat worse than ever... Fri Apr 20, 2018 3:24 pm. Student wounded in shooting at Florida high school, authorities say. By Ray Sanchez and Chuck Johnston, CNN. Updated 10:36 PM ET, Fri April 20, 2018. 4000 New: Title TBD. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 28 Apr 2020. https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-commander. How do 'select' bad actors attempt comms w/o SIGINT collection?. Rebellion or Empire?. Private [invite only] faction(s)?. Dark > Light. Q. 3994: How does Soros comm [secure] w/ DNC leaders? Q. 3995: How does China comm [secure] w/ DNC leaders? Q. 3872 GAME OVER. 17 Feb 2020. To be blunt... GAME OVER. STAR WARS COMMANDER. GAME CLOSURE ANNOUNCEMENT. We have come to the decision to shut down Star Wars: Commander on June 12, 2020. As of March 13, 2020, all in-game purchases have been suspended. 03.13.20 | 10:12.
flags: The collage's core claim — that game chat outages correlate with shootings and served as covert comms — is unverified conspiracy inference by the compiler
Shooting perpetrators named only via the embedded Wikipedia-style summary cards
Some small body text in forum posts and the closure announcement is cropped/too small for full verbatim transcription; key phrases indexed instead
